subject: Dental Appointment Rescheduled
body:
Dear $patient_name,

Your dental appointment has been rescheduled.

Previous Appointment:
- Date: $old_date
- Time: $old_time

New Appointment:
- Date: $new_date
- Time: $new_time
- Dentist: $dentist_name

If this change was not requested by you, please contact us immediately.

Best regards,
University Dental Clinic
